js-yaml 5.5.0
https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml

Vendored from the npm package js-yaml@5.5.0 (package.json "version": "5.5.0"; the browser build
carries no version banner, so this record and VendoredJSYAMLTests are where the version is kept)
https://registry.npmjs.org/js-yaml/-/js-yaml-5.5.0.tgz
(registry integrity
sha512-paNr4LFIFPjeeSmwNYdrb8FafLLG/Cr2Af3GjbsHJ5CxIjH4r0c2emlmRdAtpPAieP1gRVzk6buBbVP5gBMGAg==,
checked against the downloaded tarball before extracting it;
tarball SHA-256 23cb2e121ad69acd15fc786b7a9265a81eeeaa9f684ee73e717d6ecdbd8b0c90;
the tarball's package.json SHA-256 3ad7fe3eba5cf97410524a34ae9638f9c711cf0f25b3239c2ff2b2a604ecea1d).
js-yaml.umd.min.js is the package's dist/browser/js-yaml.umd.min.js, verbatim, including its
last line `//# sourceMappingURL=js-yaml.umd.min.js.map` (the map is not vendored; nothing asks
for it unless Web Inspector is open). It is a classic script that sets the global `jsyaml`; the
package's .mjs builds are not used (they need a module loader, which data.html does not allow).
Only data.html loads it; index.html never does.

Advisories: npm bulk advisory API and the GitHub advisory database, 2026-10-19 12:28 CST: none
for js-yaml 5.5.0 (the same lookups list GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm for 5.4.0). RELEASING.md asks for
the lookup again before every kit release.

Replacing js-yaml.umd.min.js means redoing this record; VendoredJSYAMLTests fails until the
record matches the file.

SHA-256 of each vendored file, relative to this folder:
  02970a652376ad653ff069c606ee7440b0514f52ed94a98426cb52426c8e5a02  js-yaml.umd.min.js
